_readme: THE HAULOVER GATE, WITH THE TOWN -- the playable gate scene (scenes/demos/haulover_portal.json:
the RHIB at the helm, the gate at the Merrimack's mouth into Haulover Inlet and the one back,
the sea, the minimap) with the planet's buildings and roads drawn around both inlets from the
folded tree (docs/BUILDING_LOD.md, docs/ROADS.md). The minimap draws the buildings too: the
first eye's walk about its cloud origin, seen from the second eye; its home altitude is set
so the town is there when it resets.
HELM   W / S  both throttles ahead / astern      A / D  steer to port / starboard
T / Y  take the vehicle's next / previous FORM: boat, drone, car -- one body (parts plus forms); the drone is the
recovery: flip, T to the drone, fly, T back and the boat or car is set down where the drone is
F      free the camera from the vehicle (it keeps its controls); F again returns
MINIMAP  drag to turn the planet, wheel to zoom, the button to reset over the boat
TRAVEL   the minimap's second button toggles fast travel: click the map and a spherical gate opens
ahead of the vehicle (hud.minimap.travel*: 8 m ahead, grows to 25 m over 7 s, gone at 12 s)
leading to the clicked place at your heading -- drive in, or let it swallow you
CACHE    the minimap's third button paints that map as a heat map of the tiles cached offline (docs/FIDELITY.md 7)
BRIDGES: the decks come from the tree (docs/ROADS.md). The planet tree named in layers.buildings.lod must have
been built with the two bridges sources below; rebuild it (hours, every core) with

sun._readme: The sun is a light at 0,0,0 and the Earth is placed around it -- no clock involved, so the tide above keeps its own time. This placement puts the Merrimack at sunset (+1.5 deg) and Haulover in daylight (+20.0 deg): the sun lies along the great circle from one inlet through the other.
